does: Handles the events of one spell cast in a switch on the event type. Event 0x44 is the result of the cast's interrupts: cast entity at +8, the per-roll RollAdjustments map (Guid key, 0x58 values) at +0x18, the damage roll adjustments at +0x58, and the usage map at +0x98 keyed by the creature that used interrupts, whose values (0x50: costs, then a map keyed by the interrupt entity of maps InterruptEvent to InterruptUsageEntry, 0x78) name each interrupt used, the roll it was used on (the event's RollUuid at +0) and that interrupt's own adjustments (entry +0x18). It applies them through unplaced::AdjustCastRollsByInterrupts and esv::interrupt::AdjustFunctorConditionRolls (both given event+8 / event+0x18), then adds esv::spell_cast::InterruptsUsedOneFrameComponent to each user.

evidence.says: case 0x44 passes event+8 and event+0x18 to AdjustCastRollsByInterrupts and event+0x18 to AdjustFunctorConditionRolls, then walks the keys at event+0xB8 (count +0xC4, values +0xC8) adding InterruptsUsedOneFrameComponent to each

read from inside RollAdjusted through the open frame of either caller (event = arg - 0x18): a SetRoll(1) interrupt of the host on its attack (15 to 1) and Bardic Inspiration on the host's save against a bite (total 7 to 10, its entry BaseAdjustment 3) each found under the host with the interrupt's name and the roll's Guid equal to RollUuid; the one-frame component appeared only in the next tick

questions.ask: the other event types of the switch; whether a reaction the player is asked for (Lucky) arrives through the same event
